Thanks, that log found it! The game asks for a 16-bit colour mode, and PC5's OpenGL offered it one that it then refused to set, so the game never got its OpenGL started. PC5 2.3.0 gives it the closest 32-bit mode instead, as a PC's graphics driver does. Please update, delete winedebug.txt, start the game and attach the new zip either way.

If the game works now, please close this issue: that adds it to the game compatibility list.
